FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the get-ready-with-me — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a trucking shot matching the subject's walking pace on an 8mm circular fisheye, framing with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.
